turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why did Owen find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
"Let's get this over with." You asked for this meeting, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
"Everyone knows it." That's not evidence, Hale, that's a rumour, and I'm writing it down. My child never lies. What do you have in front of you that I can read?
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
"You lawyers think you can bully anyone." I asked you a question, Hale, and you haven't answered it. What do you have in front of you that I can read?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?

"Wasting my time" is what I'd call a zero entered before anyone called me. You've had three questions, Hale, and no answer to any of them. Show me a document, or withdraw the zero and I'm going upstairs to the principal.
